toolProvenance: Built-in tools.image_gen__imagegen. Accepted terrain and environment are edits using local references; accepted sprites and avatars are fresh generations. All reference inputs were inspected before editing. Only accepted outputs are recorded here.
workflow: Independent initial generations ran concurrently. Every accepted output was visually inspected, dimensions were read from PNG metadata, and sprite real alpha was verified by decoding PNG. Files were copied unchanged from generated output paths, with no raster processing.

assets.name: terrain-painted
assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: edited terrain atlas for a polished storybook strategy board game.
Input image: the attached terrain-vibrant.png is the EDIT TARGET. Preserve its compositions, camera, six terrain identities, exact 3-column by 2-row grid, cell order and clean gutter-free boundaries.
Primary request: repaint this exact image with a lighter, softer, less saturated and less contrasty natural hand-painted gouache/storybook appearance, while retaining the existing rich terrain detail and quality. This is a thoughtful medium/style and lighting change, not simplification. Keep forest trees, clearings, clay quarry terraces and details, sheep pasture, cultivated hay fields/sheaves, mountain ridges, and desert dunes recognizable in their existing places.
Style/medium: refined traditional gouache painting by an experienced human illustrator, visible but gentle irregular brushwork, subtle paper tooth integrated into painted surfaces, believable natural miniature terrain, expressive hand-painted foliage and stone. Detailed organic forms and material variation. Avoid digitally slick sharpening, glossy game-render finish or mechanically repeated texture.
Light and palette: soft diffuse late-morning daylight, lifted natural shadows, reduced harsh black shadow contrast, restrained warm highlights. Soft pine/sage greens for the forest, distinctly lighter meadow yellow-green for sheep, muted warm terracotta for clay, soft straw-gold hay, gentle blue-gray rocks, pale warm ochre desert. Keep all terrain types clearly distinct. The result should feel lighter, calm, warm, natural and inviting without becoming washed out.
Invariants: preserve exact image aspect ratio 3:2 and precise 3x2 square-cell grid, request 1536x1024 pixels with six 512x512 squares. Row-major order remains Timber forest, Clay quarry, Sheep meadow, Hay fields, Rock mountains, Desert. Every terrain completely fills its own square; no gutters or borders. Preserve central number-token placement usability. Keep near-top-down orthographic terrain view, fine natural detail, and composition density.
Avoid: no flat vector art, no chunky toys, no reduced scene detail, no large simplified symbols, no photorealism, no hyper-gloss, no oversaturation, no extreme contrast, no heavy outlines. No text, letters, numbers, tokens, UI, logos, hexagon outlines or coastlines.
assets.inspection: Accepted after visual inspection: preserved six recognizable terrain compositions and precise grid; lifted shadows, softer gouache brushwork and lighter palette without reducing detail. Forest and pasture remain distinct.

assets.name: environment-painted
assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: edited environment material atlas for a natural hand-painted storybook strategy board game.
Input image: the attached environment.png is the EDIT TARGET. Preserve the exact 2-column by 2-row square grid, material order, top-down swatch nature, and clean gutter-free boundaries.
Primary request: repaint these same four material swatches with gentle natural gouache brushwork, softer contrast, less saturation, diffuse light, and a lighter overall palette. Retain the beautiful detailed ripples, foam, fine sand and wood-grain information. Do not simplify the materials into flat color.
Cell order remains TOP LEFT open ocean, TOP RIGHT shallow coastal water, BOTTOM LEFT sandy island ground, BOTTOM RIGHT wood tabletop. Ocean becomes softened natural muted blue/teal with gentle wave brushwork and restrained small sunlight glints. Shallow water becomes soft clear sea-glass turquoise with delicate ripples and sparse soft foam. Sand becomes warm pale natural beige/ochre with its fine texture and scattered tiny stones and subtle moss/grass flecks. Wood becomes visibly LIGHTER warm natural honey-walnut wood with delicate grain and restrained knots, matte rather than dark glossy varnish.
Style/medium: an experienced human illustrator's detailed traditional gouache painting, soft organic edges, gentle paper tooth, hand-painted material strokes, believable natural textures with no digital gloss or excessive sharpening. Light and airy but clearly readable material identities.
Invariants: square canvas, exact 2x2 layout, four equal square cells with no gutters, swatches fill canvas edge to edge. Request 1024x1024 pixels. All surfaces top-down and seamless-looking inside each cell; no horizon or scenic composition.
Avoid: no coastline shapes, no island silhouettes, no objects, no symbols, no labels, text, numbers, borders, UI, logos, watermark or grid outlines. No flat vector simplification, no loss of texture detail, no harsh black shadows, no oversaturated cyan, no dark chocolate tabletop.
assets.inspection: Accepted after visual inspection: exact 2x2 material swatches, softer water and sand texture, substantially lighter warm honey-walnut wood. Output preserved original 1254-square size rather than requested 1024.

assets.name: sprites-painted
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Create a new hand-painted gouache game sprite atlas with a genuinely transparent background and real PNG alpha.
Canvas: wide landscape 2:1 aspect ratio, request 2048x1024 pixels. Exactly four equal square columns and two equal square rows form an invisible 4x2 grid. Each of the eight square cells contains one complete isolated sprite, centered with generous transparent padding on all four sides.
Eight sprites in row-major order:
Top left: a stack of warm brown timber logs with recognizable round cut ends and natural bark.
Top second: a pile of soft terracotta-orange clay chunks.
Top third: a friendly woolly white sheep with dark face and legs.
Top right: a tied golden straw hay sheaf.
Bottom left: a cluster of cool blue-gray rocks.
Bottom second: a wooden crate holding a visible mix of timber logs, terracotta clay, golden hay and gray rocks.
Bottom third: a tall T-shaped wooden pier viewed directly from overhead, broad platform at the top, narrow landward walkway at the bottom, visible planks, pilings and two rope railings. Entire pier within its cell.
Bottom right: a small wooden sailboat viewed directly from overhead, wooden hull, mast and cream sail, entire boat within its cell.
Style: refined traditional gouache game illustration, visible human brushwork, gentle ink contours, natural handmade character and matte pigment. Medium detail, well-observed materials, readable silhouettes at tiny icon size. Soft diffuse daylight, lighter natural restrained colors, lifted shadows and gentle contrast. Warm brown bark, muted clay, cream wool, soft straw-gold, slate-blue stone and honey-toned wood. An experienced storybook illustrator's organic hand-painted finish. Avoid photorealistic rendering, plastic 3D surfaces, shiny eyes, hard glossy highlights, heavy black outlines or oversaturation. Do not simplify into flat vector icons or chunky toys.
All space outside the eight painted objects must be genuinely transparent, with real alpha. No backdrop, water, land, ground plane, drop shadows, text, letters, labels, numbers, logos, borders, grid marks or UI. Eight clean isolated sprites in the exact 4x2 ordering, output as a transparent PNG.
assets.inspection: Accepted fresh generation, no input references, after visual inspection: eight separate gouache sprites in correct grid order with medium material detail, matte brushwork, clear silhouettes, actual T-shaped pier and overhead boat. Real alpha independently verified by decoding PNG: range 0-255, 882802 fully transparent pixels out of 1573538. Use proportional cell bounds because nominal cell dimensions are 443.5 pixels.

assets.name: avatars
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: twelve character portrait medallions in one avatar atlas for a natural hand-painted storybook island trading strategy game.
Primary request: create ONE image with exactly 12 different friendly ADULT island settlers, traders, sailors and craftspeople. A precise 4-column by 3-row grid of equal SQUARE cells fills the whole canvas with no gutters. Request 1536x1152 pixels, 4:3 aspect ratio, twelve 384x384 square cells. Each cell contains one distinct circular portrait medallion with a centered head-and-shoulders bust contained fully inside the circle. Portraits are sized consistently, with clear faces readable as small circular game avatars.
Subjects: a balanced variety of women and men, young adults through older adults, varied realistic faces and skin tones, varied curly, straight, wavy, braided, cropped and gray hair; some with beards, a few wearing simple cloth caps or sun hats, others bareheaded. Friendly expressive adult personalities: curious, resourceful, warm, thoughtful, lively and quietly confident. All are fictional, distinct individuals wearing modest practical island sailor/trader/crafter linen and wool clothes in restrained muted teal, ochre, rust, sage and cream. Make every face recognizably different, avoiding a repeated generic face.
Composition: exact four equal square columns and three equal square rows, no spacing. One circular bust portrait per cell, facing forward or in a gentle three-quarter view. Keep head, hats, hair and shoulders inside the portrait circle. Quiet subtly different pastel backgrounds (cream, sage, dusty blue, pale ochre, soft clay, sea glass) inside each circular medallion, with subtle warm ivory square corners outside each circle. No border rings are necessary. No scenery or props obscuring faces.
Style/medium: refined traditional gouache storybook illustration with visible gentle handmade brushwork, delicate restrained ink accents, subtle natural paper tooth, irregular human brush edges and warm expressive faces. Medium detail, well-observed facial anatomy and adult proportions, natural small eyes, soft matte skin tones, diffuse daylight, gentle lifted shadows, low-to-moderate contrast and restrained saturation. A polished human-illustrated tabletop-game look matching detailed natural hand-painted terrain.
Avoid: no photorealism, no glossy CGI, no plastic doll faces, no giant glassy eyes, no anime, no oversmooth airbrushing, no exaggerated caricatures, no babies or children, no heavy outlines, no extreme contrast, no text, labels, letters, numbers, names, UI, watermarks, brands, logos, grid lines or gutters. Preserve exact 4x3 arrangement with twelve square cells.
assets.inspection: Accepted after visual inspection: twelve distinct friendly adult portrait medallions, varied faces, ages, skin tones, hair and clothes, expressive hand-painted detail, circular busts against quiet pastel backgrounds. Exact 4x3 grid with 362-square cells.
